Hi team,

Thanks for taking time in last week's bridge call. We walked away with a few items that are still blocking our migration to the Dedicated environment. Summary here so we can track: 

- Exception #42: KV cache eviction spikes at 75k tokens/sec — needs a config change and a short downtime window to test. 
- Exception #47: Model quantization artifacts on the 8-bit profile for customer workload (sample payloads attached).
- Security question: audit log retention policy for dedicated pools (what table(s) are exported?)

Can we confirm action owners and a target window for the downtime + test? We're sensitive to any QBR pre-read deadlines (BigBank expects a short write-up by Friday 6/25).

Attachments: security_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet with exception rows), sample_payloads.json (referenced in sheet)

– Maya Patel
Ops Lead, Acme Corp

Proposed immediate next steps (owners in parentheses):
- Reserve a black-out window for KV eviction test: Thu 6/24 02:00–03:30 PT (karthik_iyer)
- Build a short runbook for the 8-bit profile validation and fallbacks (marissa_cole)
- Confirm audit-log export table names and retention policy; capture for pre-read (lauren_bishop + security)

Please reply with any objections or schedule conflicts. I'll draft the pre-read and share a link for visibility.

Also tagging Vivek for exec alignment if we need to escalate the backup window or approval for temporary capacity bump.

Thanks — I want to close these by Friday EOD so the pre-read is crisp for BigBank.
